rubric_version.description: Rubric version used for all state vectors in this run.

depth.description: deep = many relevant institutions, full-record cap N = 12; standard = N = 8; quick = N = 4 (the only depth whose cap_n may be omitted).

cap_n.description: Max full records written before the cap (the rest go to ranked_out). Protocol defaults: deep 12, standard 8, quick 4. Optional only for depth 'quick' (default 4); deep/standard should state it (validate.py warns).

wave.description: Wave number (waves run sequentially, countries in a wave in parallel).

kind.description: programme_scan = scans multi-country programmes (candidates join the ranking); funding_route = verifies one scheme that is not tied to a country (kept as an overlay).

overlay_policy.description: How schemes with strings attached (return obligations, competitive awards) are shown, e.g. 'overlay only: never raise the base funding score; show effect and obligations next to it'.

wave_weights.description: Cost weights used to size a wave (a wave should not exceed the capacity of one usage window). Defaults when absent: deep 1.5, standard 1, quick 0.5, crosscut 0.75.

deep.description: Weight of a deep country agent.

standard.description: Weight of a standard country agent.

quick.description: Weight of a quick country agent.

benchmarks_ref.description: Path to benchmarks.json relative to RUN_DIR (02_map/benchmarks.json).

funded_definition.description: What 'funded' means in this run (copied from life_plan.money; LP-G3 turned into numbers).

type.description: stipend_and_tuition = tuition-free AND a living stipend; tuition_only = tuition covered, living costs paid by the person; affordable = the person pays, below max_out_of_pocket.

max_total_tuition.description: Ceiling for total tuition over the whole degree (null = none).

max_out_of_pocket.description: Ceiling for everything the applicant pays themselves over the whole degree (null = none).

living_support_required_monthly.description: Monthly living support the funding must provide for the whole household (null = none).

household_size.description: People the living support must cover (applicant + dependants).

min_funding_score.description: Lowest funding-axis score that still counts as 'funded' for this applicant. Used by the follow-up stop rule. Default if absent: 3 for stipend_and_tuition, 2 for tuition_only, 1 for affordable (followups.py prints which value it used).

eligibility_facts_ref.description: Pointer to the eligibility facts, normally '01_life_plan/life_plan.json#eligibility_facts'. Facts are not duplicated here.

exclusions.description: Countries/regions/programme types excluded, with the reason. Either {country, reason} objects (preferred) or plain strings such as 'X: reason'.

country.description: Country, region or programme type excluded.

session_plan.description: How the search is spread over usage windows.

agents_per_window_estimate.description: Agents that fit in one usage window (update from run_state.agents_per_window_observed).
